titles_native.title: 失恋伯爵令嬢と俺様騎士団長～一夜限りの関係なので、溺愛しないでください～

description:
Damie finds herself waking up after a one-night stand with the most notorious playboy in the capital, Acard Valerian. The night was an impulsive decision as she had her heart broken just the day before, when her first love, manipulated by her heinous step-brother, cruelly told her to “find someone else.” 

Fed up with all of this, she decided to seduce the incredibly handsome man who had just arrived in the North, Acard Valerian, who is not only incredibly beautiful, but also an utterly lustfilled bastard. 

“Your face is pretty when you cry.”  
It seems he has chosen the wrong opponent and is now playing with fire.
